title: SOC2 prep scratchpad - Natalie Ross
content:
Quick notes + running checklist for SOC2 Type 2 prep (scratchpad)

Context: pulling together evidence for 12-month period. Primary focus: logical access, change management, incident response, vendor mgmt, and monitoring/alerting controls. This is a messy working doc - lots of TODOs and open questions.

High-level plan:
- Inventory controls mapped to Trust Services Criteria (security, availability, confidentiality)
- Identify evidence artifacts (logs, configs, review notes, runway for 12mo retention)
- Owners assigned and evidence collection deadlines
- Gap remediation (low/med/high) tracked in ENG-1428

Immediate TODOs:
- [ ] Confirm SRE log retention window matches control SC-1 (do we store audit logs for 12 months?) - Owner: Evan (due 2024-10-20)
- [ ] Pull IAM admin role review report for last 12 months (ad-hoc reviews + approvals) - Owner: Maya (due 2024-10-18)
- [ ] Get snapshot of dedicated/private deployment onboarding docs for vendor mgmt control - Owner: Diego (due 2024-10-25)
- [ ] Validate backup & restore rehearsals documented (dates + outcomes) - Owner: Natalie (due 2024-10-22)

Control mapping notes (rough):
- CC: Logical Access (LA):
  - Evidence: IAM audit logs, MFA enforcement policy, admin access change tickets (GH/Linear), access review worksheets
  - Known gaps: ad-hoc account offboarding sometimes lacks ticket reference (SaaS onboarding flow). Workaround: create mandatory offboarding checklist in HR-IT flow.

- CC: Change Management (CM):
  - Evidence: PR review records, deployment runbooks, rollback tests, change approval tickets (Jira ENG-*)
  - Risk: infra changes in private deployments occasionally follow different runbook (customer-managed). Need to capture exception process and approvals.

- CC: Incident Response (IR):
  - Evidence: Incident postmortems (Confluence), pagerduty incident logs, communication artifacts (Slack threads), tabletop exercise notes
  - Open: need to confirm time-to-detect metric source and runbook versioning.

- CC: Monitoring & Alerting (MA):
  - Evidence: PagerDuty schedule, alert runbooks, metric dashboards screenshots, escalation matrix
  - TODO: export Grafana snapshots for last 12 months for key SLOs (latency, error-rate) and store in evidence bucket.

Evidence storage & chain of custody (notes):
- Preferred source: immutable logs (S3 bucket w/ versioning) or direct exports (Cloud Audit Logs)
- Temporary: screenshots are ok for early drafts but need primary artifacts before audit
- Naming convention: soc2/<control>/<YYYY-MM-DD>_<owner>_<artifact-type> (helps map in evidence index)

Open questions / to confirm with auditors:
- Do they accept ticket references + links as primary evidence or want exported PDFs of tickets? (ask audit team)
- Level of detail for customer-managed private deployments - auditor may want documented contract and onboarding checklist 
- For backup testing, do they require live restore into prod-like env or is tabletop + logs sufficient?

Risks & mitigation ideas (quick):
- Risk: inconsistent offboarding -> Mitigation: enforce HR->IT webhook to create offboard ticket; weekly orphaned-account reports
- Risk: alert noise -> Mitigation: implement alert tuning sprint; document triage thresholds and reduce duplicates
- Risk: evidence sprawl -> Mitigation: central evidence bucket + index file (CSV) with pointers and owner metadata

Notes for evidence collection workflow (draft):
1) Create index CSV in private evidence bucket: columns = control, artifact_name, path, owner, created_at, notes
2) Owners upload artifact + add index row. Tag artifacts with control id.
3) Weekly sync to review newly added artifacts; escalate missing ones.
4) Freeze evidence 2 weeks before auditor access window (read-only snapshot)

Meeting notes + next steps (from 2024-10-09 sync):
- Agreed: use Confluence SOC2-Prep Index as the single source of truth for control narratives (Natalie to update)
- Maya to run an automated IAM review report (script in infra repo PR#231) and drop CSV into evidence bucket
- Evan to confirm log retention policy and open infra ticket if retention < 12mo
- Diego to collate vendor contracts for private deployment vendors (contract + security questionnaire)

Random scratch ideas:
- Could we add a lightweight checklist into the Console for Dedicated customers to capture evidence of customer-managed config? Might be overkill but could simplify audits for them.
- Consider a small internal perf test email to execs summarizing risk posture + top 3 remediation asks before auditor arrives.

Links referenced:
- Confluence index: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SOC2/SOC2-Prep-Index
- Infra PR for IAM report: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/231
- Audit ticket: ENG-1428
- Slack thread about log retention: #security-audit (see pinned messages)

Notes to self: capture one example of each evidence type (ticket, log, screenshot, signed contract) to ensure format works for auditors. Keep this doc messy - it's the working brain dump.
